Assuming a diameter of ~30 cm and thickness of ~3 cm, the volume is approx 0.0021 m³. The mass would be roughly 1.5 kg. The primary material is wood, which has moderate friction (0.4-0.6) and low restitution (0.3-0.5). A convex hull or convex decomposition would be appropriate for collision modeling, though a simple cylinder approximation might suffice if the handle isn't critical for interaction. Given the handle, a convex decomposition is safer for accurate gripping simulation. Default contact offsets are fine. CCD is not strictly necessary unless thrown or manipulated at high speeds.
